Usually, each deliverable unit is recognized as a performance obligation. These deliverables typically consist of technical laboratory reports, samples and/or products for commercial manufacturing. Revenue from these contractual elements is recognized at the point when the deliverable units are accepted by the customers. The contracts typically include milestones-based payment schedules, requiring stage payments throughout the service period upon reaching specified milestones. The Group's performance does not create an asset with alternative future use since the Group cannot redirect the asset for use on another customer, and at the same time the Group has a present right to payment from the customers for services performed only upon acceptance of the deliverable units by the customers.
